cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. They're calling your audition number. Do you want the part enough to let them hear you? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want it. I don't want them laughing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I can walk you in or drive you home. Which want am I helping?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Walk me in, but promise they won't laugh.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can promise I'll stay. Is that enough to risk the audition, or are we going home?

mechanism: A leads an audition departure but negotiates accompaniment so B must choose the desired part over guaranteed emotional protection.
confusable: Unlike mere encouragement, A refuses a guarantee against humiliation and presents the choice; borrowed authority changes support to keep B moving.
comparison: A practical escort before an audition differs from partners deciding whether to hear a hard answer over dinner.
seedUse: D106-a audition and laughter dilemma supplies the choice; S02-b adapting the method supplies the manner of leading.
